title: Affine identity for density expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a nonnegative function on $\mathbb F_2^n$ with uniform expectation $1$, and let $h:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. Define the expectation weighted by $\varphi$ by $\mathbb E_\varphi[g]=\mathbb E_x[\varphi(x)g(x)]$, where $x$ is uniform on $\mathbb F_2^n$. Then $2\mathbb E_\varphi[h]-1=\mathbb E_\varphi[2h-1]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$ (pointwise nonnegative and uniform expectation one)
$h$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
